mapper.select: SELECT pr.id as id, pr.end_time as endTime, pr.start_time as startTime, pr.discount_price as discountPrice, p.name as productName, p.product_image as productImage FROM promotion pr INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = pr.product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion ( product_id, end_time, start_time, discount_price ) VALUES ( #{promotionInfo.productId}, #{promotionInfo.endTime}, #{promotionInfo.startTime}, #{promotionInfo.discountPrice} )
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion SET product_id = #{promotionInfo.productId}, end_time = #{promotionInfo.endTime}, start_time = #{promotionInfo.startTime}, discount_price = #{voucherInfo.discountPrice} WHERE id = #{promotionId}
